title: World cannot select and use an external Library tileset as separate tiles
reproduction: Select Tiles and choose a regular PNG tileset.
Try to choose one tile and place it in the world.
expected: Choose a cell from the sheet, then place/save that exact tile.
actual: World initially filters image; tilesets follow irregular object compilation and first-template/full-sheet preview, with no tile selector.
evidence: Player report: quiero usar un tileset de biblioteca y no me deja
world:image picker filter; compileVisual always called analyzeAssetSheetPixels
owner_hint: Kelo Creator Asset Bridge + Library Build Bridge

research.summary: Image-only entry and irregular object analysis cannot express a regular tile grid. Existing source-rectangle property templates can.

known_facts.statement: World picker initializes kind=image, excluding tileset.
Tileset visual compilation uses foreground-object segmentation with no grid selection.

external_references.title: Tiled editing tilesets
external_references.lesson: Regular cells require tile dimensions, margin and spacing.

attempt_history.goal: Choose and place an exact tile through canonical Studio placement

change.summary: Preserve regular grid cells and show paged cell picker before placement.

attempt_history.conclusion: Candidate awaits exact-build flow and physical Safari confirmation.

next_best_actions.action: Run exact PR tileset test, then inspect the same selection/placement on physical Safari.
next_best_actions.reason: Tile stamps must retain exact crop and persist through reopen.
next_best_actions.expected_signal: Selected cell places, saves and reopens; no full-sheet stamp.
next_best_actions.stop_condition: Missing crop, placement, persisted tile or frozen mobile UI.

fix.summary: Grid compilation, metadata preservation and bounded tile chooser under existing owners.

verification.method: Exact PR mobile tileset and sustained walk; physical Safari pending.

notes: Tile stamps use existing placement; automatic terrain topology and server publication are separate existing contracts.
